mentions.name: Exarchos
mentions.description: Exarchos is an SDLC workflow harness for AI agents. Rather than encoding typical development workflows as skills (e.g., creating a PRD, planning with TDD, dispatching subagents), it uses a concurrent event-sourced process manager to handle the workflow orchestration.
mentions.problem: Encoding typical software development workflows as agent skills is inadequate; a concurrent event-sourced process manager handles them instead.
mentions.source_excerpt: It's an SDLC workflow harness for agents. Instead of using skills to encode my typical workflows (e.g., create PRD, then create plan using TDD, then dispatch subagents, etc) I've built a concurrent event-sourced process manager to handle it.

evidence.value: It's an SDLC workflow harness for agents. Instead of using skills to encode my typical workflows (e.g., create PRD, then create plan using TDD, then dispatch subagents, etc) I've built a concurrent event-sourced process manager to handle it.
